Create a Swatchplot of Palettes

Source: R/swatchplot.R
swatchplot.Rd

swatchplot() creates a plot of color swatches for the various palettes included in this package.

Usage

swatchplot(palette = NULL, style = "generic", font = NULL)

Arguments

palette

must be NULL or one of the palettes included in this package. If NULL (the default value), the swatchplot returns swatches for palettes.

style

passed to theme_steve() in the construction of the plot. Defautls to "generic" for testing purposes. Consult the documentation for theme_steve() for more information.

font

defaults to NULL and used only when the style argument is "custom". Used for specifying the font of the user's choice that, one assumes, is available on their computer.

Value

swatchplot() returns a plot of the colors available in a requested palette, or all available palettes, as a ggplot2 object.

Details

The palette argument must be NULL or one of the palettes included in this package and listed in the palettes data frame in this package. If the palette requested is a diverging or sequential palette, the swatchplot returns all colors in the palette for a length of 2 to 9 (the maximum). If the palette requested is qualitative, the swatchplot is all colors in the palette and their position in it.

Author

Steven V. Miller

Examples


swatchplot()

swatchplot("d-suBF")

swatchplot("s-suO")

swatchplot("q-martel")
